implementation.credential_storage: external secret-manager reference and non-secret metadata only

security_contracts: organization and source Agent are the leading query scope
connector type is immutable and updates require expected_version
Agent self-loop, cycle, depth and fan-out are bounded
MCP and A2A require canonical HTTPS and reject userinfo, query, fragment and non-443 ports
loopback, private, link-local, metadata, CGNAT, unspecified, multicast and reserved IPs are blocked
CN enabled external connectors require an exact host egress allowlist
JSON Schema dialect, depth, nodes, external references and risky regex are bounded
secret-shaped config keys and values are rejected
validation responses for connector paths strip rejected input values
credential references are write-only and never occur in ConnectorResponse
mutations require owner or admin organization role
configuration changes emit minimum-necessary tenant audit records
connector delete creates an invisible tombstone so execution audit foreign keys remain valid
not_yet_implemented: connector execution engine and mock execution E2E
connection-time DNS pinning and redirect revalidation
OAuth token exchange and provider-side credential resolution
connector circuit breakers, retry and execution budgets
PostgreSQL multi-process locking and Docker Linux E2E
completion_claim: resource CRUD complete; execution path partial
reason: The persistent five-type resource and security CRUD slice is complete, but this does not claim a production connector runner or Corti hosted-service equivalence.
